title: phlebodium polylepis
intro: Phlebodium polylepis, commonly known as the Resurrection Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of air plant that has the unique ability to dry out and then revive itself when watered. The health benefits of Phlebodium polylepis include its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
